parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or STS temporary authorization.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL on your Alibaba Cloud DevOps page. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.

parameters.name: pushRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the push rule to update.

parameters.name: repositoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the repository that contains the push rule.
